# Results — Study 821 (Turnover Volatility)

*Generated by [`examples/verify.py`](../examples/verify.py). The claim under test —
Chordia, Subrahmanyam & Anshuman (2001): stocks whose daily turnover is most **variable**
(a high **coefficient of variation** of turnover) earn **lower** future returns, so a
long-low-vol / short-high-vol book should earn a positive spread. Offline & deterministic
once cached; run `python examples/verify.py` to reproduce every number.
As-of 2026-06-30 (the last complete calendar month; the partial current month is dropped).
Fingerprint `357fd262912f` (panel Close).*

## Data stamp

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Real tape | yfinance daily OHLC **+ Volume** (`auto_adjust=True`, total-return), **50 liquid US large-caps**, 2010-01-04 → 2026-06-30, **4,147** dated rows/name |
| Universe | a fixed `UNIVERSE` of ~50 mega-caps, pulled through the **`quantlab.universe` survivorship guard** (`download_panel(..., allow_survivorship_bias=True)`), cached under this study's own `_cache/` |
| Signal | each name's **trailing-63-day coefficient of variation of daily share turnover** (std/mean, scale-invariant so raw Volume ≡ fixed-shares turnover), known at the close of `t−1` (one `shift`) |
| Sort | each day rank the cross-section by the signal; **long the bottom 30%** (low turnover-vol), **short the top 30%** (high turnover-vol), equal-weight; measure the day-`t` forward return of each book |
| Execution / costs | one documented lag: signal through close `t−1` → hold day `t`. The costed timer charges 2 sides × one-way cost × NAV per day on the long-short book; the short book pays 50 bps/yr borrow |
| Statistics | Newey-West (HAC, 10-lag) *t* on the daily spread; one-sample *t*; Welch *t* on the pooled low-vs-high books; a 1,000-permutation placebo; a two-era cut; a dollar-volume variant; a 20-seed synthetic positive control |

**Survivorship — named on the Signal axis.** `UNIVERSE` is a **current-membership** list
of names that are liquid mega-caps *today*, so the magnitudes are an **upper bound**. The
CSA turnover-variability premium is documented as a small/illiquid-stock effect; a
50-mega-cap survivor panel is exactly where it is *least* likely to appear — which is what
we find.

## The headline — long-low-vol / short-high-vol spread

Daily equal-weight bottom-30% minus top-30% turnover-CV spread (n = **4,084** days):

| quantity | value |
|---|--:|
| **spread (long low-vol − short high-vol)** | **−1.70 bps/day** |
| Newey-West(10) *t* | **−1.73** |
| one-sample *t* | −1.67 |
| low-vol book / high-vol book | +5.95 bps / +7.65 bps (Welch *t* = −0.65) |
| gross spread Sharpe (no cost) | −0.41 |

The claimed edge **does not replicate.** Chordia-Subrahmanyam-Anshuman predict a
*positive* long-low/short-high spread (steady-turnover names out-earn); on this mega-cap
universe the spread is a statistically **insignificant −1.70 bps/day** (NW *t* = −1.73,
|*t*| < 2), and if anything faintly *wrong-signed* — the erratic-turnover names slightly
out-earned. The claimed premium is simply **absent** here.

## Placebo — is the (weak, reversed) tilt a lucky alignment of the sort?

Keep the trailing-CV sort but read each day's forward returns from a **column-permuted**
panel (signal → outcome link broken), 1,000 permutations (20 seeds × 50):

| quantity | value |
|---|--:|
| observed spread | **−1.70 bps** |
| placebo mean (sd) | +0.040 bps (0.931) |
| position of observed | ≈ **1.87σ into the left tail** (right-tail p = 0.971) |

The permutation null centres at zero; the observed −1.70 bps sits only ~1.9σ into the
left tail — consistent with the insignificant HAC *t*. There is no reliable spread of
either sign.

## Robustness — two eras (split 2018-01-01)

| era | spread | NW *t* |
|---|--:|--:|
| 2010-01 → 2018-01 (n=1,950) | −3.00 bps | **−2.21** |
| 2018-01 → 2026-06 (n=2,134) | −0.51 bps | **−0.36** |

The faint (wrong-signed) tilt is carried **entirely by the pre-2018 era** and vanishes
post-2018 — not a stable relation, and never the claimed *positive* sign.

## Dollar-volume variant — turnover = Volume × Close

| quantity | value |
|---|--:|
| spread | −1.64 bps/day |
| Newey-West(10) *t* | −1.68 |

Switching the turnover proxy to dollar volume leaves the picture unchanged: insignificant,
same faint wrong sign.

## The timer — can you get paid for it?

Charge 2 sides × one-way × NAV per day on the long-short book; short pays 50 bps/yr borrow.

| one-way cost | gross/day | cost/day | net/day | *t* (net) | Sharpe (net) | ~ann. |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| **1 bp** | −1.70 bps | 2.14 bps | **−3.84 bps** | −3.76 | −0.93 | −9.7%/yr |
| **5 bps** | −1.70 bps | 10.14 bps | **−11.84 bps** | −11.60 | −2.88 | −29.8%/yr |

The specified book loses money gross; and even a *sign-flipped* book (long high-vol) would
earn only +1.70 bps/day gross, which the 2.14 bps/day round-trip friction at a mere 1 bp
one-way already eats. **Mirage** either way.

## Synthetic positive control — the machinery is unbiased

Deterministic seeded OHLCV panel: each name carries a fixed latent turnover-vol tilt that
inflates its volume dispersion (its CV of turnover) and — with `edge>0` — depresses its
forward mean return. No network.

| world | spread NW *t* |
|---|--:|
| null (`edge = 0`), **20 seeds** | mean **+0.21** (sd 1.01), **\|t\| ≥ 2 in 0/20 seeds** |
| planted (`edge = 0.0016`, seed 821) | **+9.33** (Welch *t* = +9.65) |

The detector recovers a *planted* CSA relation cleanly and never fires on the null — so the
insignificant real-tape result is a genuine absence of the effect on the mega-cap universe,
not a broken sort. *(A faithful-engine / power check only — never cited in support of the
real-tape stamp.)*

## Verdict

- **Signal — NONE.** The famous Chordia-Subrahmanyam-Anshuman turnover-variability premium
  does **not** replicate on 50 liquid US mega-caps. The specified long-low-vol /
  short-high-vol spread is a statistically **insignificant −1.70 bps/day** (NW *t* =
  **−1.73**, |*t*| < 2), faintly *wrong-signed* versus the claim, carried entirely by the
  pre-2018 era (−3.00 bps, *t* = −2.21) and gone thereafter (−0.51 bps, *t* = −0.36); the
  dollar-volume variant agrees, and the placebo shows no reliable spread. The 20-seed
  synthetic control recovers a *planted* relation cleanly (*t* = +9.33, fires on 0/20
  nulls), so the machinery is sound — the claimed edge is simply absent on mega-caps (a
  small/illiquid-stock effect). Survivorship biases the magnitude.
- **Tradability — MIRAGE.** The specified book loses money gross and net (−3.84 bps/day at
  1 bp, −11.84 at 5 bps); even the sign-flip is eaten by the round-trip friction at 1 bp.
